theme_strategy.rationale: Edtech platform for Brazilian elementary (Anos Finais 6º-9º) and high school (Ensino Médio 1ª-3ª) students. Needs vibrant, encouraging Duolingo/Quizizz tactile energy combined with Khan Academy clarity, supporting daylight classroom visibility and nighttime study sessions with full dark mode and accessibility toolbar toggle.

entry_surfaces./: gamified education portal landing with active student/teacher role switcher, school logo badge bar, quick stat counters and interactive preview of Trilhas BNCC & Missão ENEM
entry_surfaces./login: split branded auth screen — school branding & Milton I.A mission left, role-aware quick login form (Estudante / Professor / Gestor) right
entry_surfaces./estudante: student hub — Duolingo-inspired weekly quest bar top, circular Trilha step map center, Milton I.A Tutor floating launcher right, XP leaderboard widget side
entry_surfaces./quiz: gamified interactive quiz arena — progress bar with streak multiplier header, dynamic question card (multiple-choice/V-F/association/gap-fill), instant feedback modal with BNCC skill explainers
entry_surfaces./enem: Missão ENEM command room — countdown timer, 4 knowledge areas + Redação simulado cards with radar statistics and timer
entry_surfaces./mural: school multimedia feed with filter tags (tirinhas, vídeos curtos, infográficos, avisos), like/share interactions and admin quick-publisher
entry_surfaces./tutor: Milton I.A adaptive conversational learning assistant with grade-level picker (6º-9º, 1ª-3ª EM), prompt templates (Resumo, Explicar Simples, Criar Questões, Mapa Mental)
entry_surfaces./professor: educator workstation — quiz generator wizard, media manager, student analytics & class mastery gradebook
entry_surfaces./gestor: institutional management cockpit — school logo/name customization, real-time engagement rate, SEDUC-SP curriculum tracking & export tools

component_hierarchy.description: Sticky top bar with customizable School Logo + School Name, prominent 'Milton I.A' badge, XP pills, Daily Streak flame counter, Accessibility Toolbar launcher, Theme toggle, and User Profile menu
Accessibility bar with font size scaler (A- / A / A+), High Contrast toggle (Preto/Amarelo WCAG AAA), Text-to-Speech (Leitura por Voz via Web Speech API), and Simplified Navigation mode
Student status banner with dynamic Level (e.g. Nível 7 - Explorador Cósmico), XP progress bar towards next level, 7/15/30-day streak indicator with fire animations, and unlocked Medals shelf

Curricular learning paths organized by Grade (6º-9º Fundamental, 1ª-3ª EM), Bimester (1º ao 4º Bimestre), Subject (Matemática, Língua Portuguesa, Ciências, História, Geografia, etc.) tagged with BNCC & Currículo Paulista codes (e.g. EF09MA06, EM13LP01)

Gamified Quiz Engine supporting: 1) Rápido (5 q's), 2) Completo (10 q's), 3) Desafio Master (20 q's). Formats: Múltipla Escolha, V/F, Associação (coluna A e B), Complete a Frase. Features combo streaks, sound-effect toggles, XP animations and detailed feedback with commented solutions

Showcase of 7 official medals: 🥉 Aprendiz, 🥈 Explorador, 🥇 Cientista, 🏆 Mestre do Conhecimento, 🎯 Especialista em Matemática, 📖 Leitor Nota 10, 🔬 Jovem Pesquisador with unlock criteria, progress percentage and celebratory modal
Rankings view with tabs (Diário, Semanal, Mensal, Geral) and scopes (Minha Turma, Minha Escola, Ranking Estadual SP) with podium avatars and rank badges

Simulado ENEM module covering: Linguagens e Códigos, Matemática e suas Tecnologias, Ciências da Natureza, Ciências Humanas, and Laboratório de Redação com cronômetro oficial (05:00:00 e 05:30:00) e análise de desempenho por competência TRI
Study library with curated materials: Apostilas SEDUC-SP (Aprender Sempre, Caderno do Aluno), Slides interativos, PDFs, Links úteis, with search by discipline, grade, and keyword
Educational multimedia wall: Educational comics (tirinhas), infographics, bite-sized vertical video player (< 3 min), pinned school announcements, with filter tabs and admin upload/schedule modal

Interactive AI pedagogical tutor powered by LLM backend with student-grade tone adapter, prompt chips (Explicar como se eu tivesse 12 anos, Gerar 3 questões treino, Resumir este texto, Gerar mapa mental), and voice input/output
Teacher workstation to build quizzes, auto-generate BNCC questions with Milton I.A, publish study guides to classes, and inspect real-time performance analytics per class/student

Administrative control center with custom School Name & School Logo editor, student/teacher user roster, class engagement KPIs, daily active user charts (Recharts), and SEDUC-SP curriculum coverage report

image_urls.description: Estudantes engajados em sala de aula utilizando dispositivos digitais para aprendizado gamificado
Estudante focado em notebook realizando trilha e simulado
Edifício escolar moderno representando a infraestrutura da instituição pública ou privada de ensino

visual_enhancers.gamification_buttons: Duolingo-style 3D tactile buttons with 4px bottom border offset (e.g. `border-b-4 active:border-b-0 active:translate-y-1 transition-all rounded-2xl shadow-sm`)
visual_enhancers.card_borders: Subtle 1px border with crisp `rounded-2xl` and slight top highlight for elevated tactile feel
visual_enhancers.mascot_badges: Milton I.A robot mascot avatar with friendly animated pulse rings and status lights for live guidance
visual_enhancers.particles_and_confetti: CSS/Canvas confetti bursts upon Quiz completion or Medal unlock
visual_enhancers.accessibility_focus: High visibility 3px focus rings (`focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500`) for complete keyboard navigation

motion.quiz_option_tap: Scale down to 0.98 on press, pop back on release with instant green/red border feedback
motion.xp_counter: Staggered numeric count-up animation when points are awarded
motion.streak_fire: Gentle pulsating flame SVG motion on daily streak icon
motion.modal_transitions: Smooth spring-based scale and fade in/out using motion/react
motion.prefers_reduced_motion: All kinetic animations must be disabled when user prefers reduced motion or turns on Simplified Navigation

accessibility.wcag_level: WCAG 2.1 AA & partial AAA (High Contrast mode)
accessibility.screen_reader_support: Aria labels on all interactive icons (streak, xp, medals, timer, audio buttons)
accessibility.text_to_speech: Integrated Web Speech API (window.speechSynthesis) with pt-BR voice selector for reading quiz questions and AI Tutor explanations
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Logical tab indexing across questions (keys 1-4 for options, Enter for confirm, Space for next)
accessibility.font_resizing: Dynamic root CSS variables `--app-font-multiplier` for seamless instant 100%, 115%, 130% scaling without layout break

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the complete Milton I.A educational ecosystem in Portuguese (Brazil) with extreme attention to detail, modern Duolingo/Quizizz/Khan Academy gamification feel, and full compliance with BNCC / Currículo Paulista (SEDUC-SP).
Ensure both Light Mode and Dark Mode look pristine, with rich contrast and a dedicated High Contrast (Preto/Amarelo) accessibility preset.
Make School Logo and School Name fully customizable in Gestor settings and instantly reactive across the whole application.

Include pre-seeded sample data for all 6º-9º Ensino Fundamental and 1ª-3ª Ensino Médio series, with rich questions, BNCC codes (e.g., EF08MA01, EM13LP02), Simulados ENEM, and study library documents (SEDUC-SP Aprender Sempre).
Integrate the Milton I.A AI Tutor with interactive pre-configured prompt helpers and streaming chat simulation with curriculum-aligned tone.
Add full role simulation (Estudante, Professor, Gestor) switchable easily with one click in the header/login so all features can be demonstrated effortlessly.
Include sound effects (synthesized with Web Audio API or audio elements) for correct/wrong answers and level ups, with a mute toggle in settings.

Every single interactive button, input, tab, card, and metric must include explicit `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="btn-iniciar-quiz"`, `data-testid="select-serie-filtro"`, `data-testid="counter-xp-total"`).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_slop: Do not create empty generic centered layouts. Use tactile asymmetric bento cards, colorful progress pills, live avatar rankings, and genuine educational content in Brazilian Portuguese.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.ui_richness: Ensure rich visual depth with 3D tactile buttons, medal showcases, streak flames, interactive charts, and accessible toolbars.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.test_readiness: All interactive triggers must have kebab-case `data-testid`.
